198: func createServer(addr string, group []*Config) (caddy.Server, error) {
199: 	switch tr, _ := parse.Transport(addr); tr {
200: 	case transport.DNS:
201: 		return NewServer(addr, group)
202: 	case transport.TLS:
203: 		return NewServerTLS(addr, group)
204: 	case transport.QUIC:
205: 		return NewServerQUIC(addr, group)
206: 	case transport.GRPC:
207: 		return NewServergRPC(addr, group)
208: 	case transport.HTTPS:
209: 		return NewServerHTTPS(addr, group)
210: 	default:
211: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown transport: %s", tr)
212: 	}
213: }
